chapter_title: Concerning these Names: God, Rich One, and Angel; who they are.
chapter_note: The chapter is largely a systematic, internal-to-the-cosmic-system taxonomy of three naming-levels (god/rich one/angel) across successive emanational sequences. It is wrapped in a hagiographic Q&A opening (¶1–2) and contains two dialogue-attribution seams (¶3, ¶10) that must be stripped. The late/Christian-leaning vocabulary in ¶9 (“apostolate”) reads as Mani-community diction applied to a still-cosmological mission sequence rather than an NT citation or institutional graft.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic opening (“Once again the enlightener speaks”) plus meta-linguistic framing (“people pronounce it with their mouths”) and interrogative setup; functions as editorial container rather than impersonal substrate exposition.
Disciples’ request formula (“Tell us, our master”) is classic dialogue frame; no cosmological mechanism expounded.

paragraphs.core_text: There are these three archetypes [in the land of light, and there is no measure to] them!
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue attribution (“The apostle speaks to them:”), a Layer-2 compilation frame marker (especially ‘apostle’).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Underlying line is impersonal cosmological classification (three archetypes in the land of light; immeasurability), but introduced by later dialogue framing.

paragraphs.core_text: So, the ones who are called 'god', are the gods whom the Father has summoned from himself. He has established them after the likeness of his greatness.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic emanational definition within the cosmic system (Father → summoned gods → likeness of greatness); no citation or institutional application.

paragraphs.core_text: Conversely, these who are named 'rich [ ... ]', are the evocations of the first rich gods of the Father; because, when the Father had summoned (the first), they themselves summoned evocations. They called them 'rich'.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the triadic degree structure (second-order evocations) with internal causality; lacuna preserved; no reach into contemporary institutions.

paragraphs.core_text: They too, the rich ones, have summoned their evocations. They call them 'angel'. These are the three archetypes who occur in the land of light. There is no measure to apply to them!
paragraphs.temporal_note: Completes the three-step emanational chain (god → rich one → angel) and reiterates the archetypal/immeasurable register—hallmarks of the substrate’s structural voice.

paragraphs.core_text: Once again, listen! Other persons who are named 'god' are the emanations who have come from the Father; the evocations of the Father whom he summoned forth. They came out to the contest and humiliated the enmity.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second sequence applies the same naming taxonomy to a temporal/cosmic phase (contest with enmity) but remains cosmos→cosmos; the exhortative “listen” here reads as didactic rhetoric, not institutional address.

paragraphs.core_text: Conversely, the 'rich ones' are the evocations of these first living words. They too, the rich ones, have come and performed and fulfilled the pleasure of the greatness, in the worlds that are above and below.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues systematic tiering (“first living words” → “rich ones”) with functional description spanning cosmic regions; no contemporary referents.

paragraphs.core_text: On the other hand, the ones who are named the 'angels' are the evocations of the rich ones, who had come from the three living words. They have been sent in an embassy and an apostolate to this building. They have come to the entire divinity, which is established in silence and in hiddenness. And, also, they have come to all the souls who have been entangled in the enemy. They have brought them hope and confidence.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Still an internal cosmological mission description (angels as third-order envoys to the cosmos/souls). The term “apostolate” may reflect later Mani-community diction, but there is no Gospel/NT citation and no cosmos→institution mapping.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, they are called 'god', all the gods who belong to the household of the Great Spirit.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed hagiographic speech attribution (“Once again the enlightener speaks:”).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Teaching content is a further systematic application of the naming taxonomy to a cosmic ‘household’ series; framing formula indicates later editorial packaging.

paragraphs.core_text: Conversely, the ones who are called 'angel', are all the angels who belong to the household of the Beloved of the Lights.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic-internal classification (“household of the Beloved of the Lights”); despite computational ‘application’ flag, there is no second-person exhortation or institutional identification.

paragraphs.core_text: The ones who are called 'rich', are all the rich ones who belong to the household of the glorious Ambassador.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Completes the third series by mapping the naming-term to a cosmic household (glorious Ambassador); impersonal, structural closure of the triad.
